race.comment: ROYAL CORPORAL (2) has strung together a couple of minor placings under big weights. Caught the eye last start when he powered home to be beaten just over a length by subsequent winner Graffiti Tycoon in a BM64 at Randwick. That form is good enough for a race of this calibre. WAR BANNER (8) started deep in the red and led all the way for a soft win on debut over 1200m at Kembla recently. Beautifully bred colt who can take this next step. REGAL (9) defeated all but the promising Priory Park over 1200m at Warwick Farm last start. On-pacer with room to improve at the fourth run of her maiden campaign. LIPSTICK (7) has placed at all three runs here and at all three first-up appearances so she must be respected coming off a 20-week break. TIME TO DANCE (6) has savaged the line in his two runs this prep. Draws a bit closer today and the small field suits. Right in contention.
